{{Quote|There's a droid you've got to find. It's a series Tee-Oh, classification number 10-4. Nickname's Bug Eyes. Seems it got its operating parameter mixed up somehow, and is for all purposes lost. It's carrying data vital to the resistance movement&mdash;what, exactly, I don't know.|Nick Rostu to Jax Pavan|<ref name="JT" />}}
'''10-4TO''' was a rogue [[TO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], also known as '''Bug Eyes''', whose databank was rumored to contain vital plans for the [[Whiplash]] resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and its rumored data were in fact a lure devised by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to attract the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]], whom he sought in order to obtain a [[pyronium]] nugget given to him [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. The droid was then set loose on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in hopes of being found by Pavan, who was reported to be working with the resistance. Pavan's master began looking for the droid. The Jedi Master encountered the ex-Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nick Rostu]] after being mortally wounded by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and asked Rostu to pass on the mission to find 10-4TO to Pavan, which he did. Later, Vader had Rostu captured and sent him to find Pavan. 10-4TO could be controlled by the single phrase "''zu woohama''," which would cause it to obey the individual who had most recently spoken the phrase. The droid was also capable of delivering powerful [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] blasts to organic creatures with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] mounted in its left [[Limb/Legends|arm]].

The ostensible value of its databanks made it the objective of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] final mission on the path to becoming a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. The head of Black Sun, [[Dal Perhi]], sent Xizor to find and locate the droid. However, Perhi had noticed Xizor's ambition and the mission to locate the droid was a ruse to have a Black Sun [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Kaird]], eliminate Xizor. The plan failed, and Kaird was captured by Xizor, who had found and controlled 10-4TO by this point. Xizor took Kaird and 10-4TO to the [[Factory District]], where he planned to have Kaird brainwashed, but instead, [[feral droid]]s had destroyed [[Xizor's laboratory|his facility]].

At this point, the trio were found by Pavan and his party. Though initially subdued, Rostu, who had joined up with Pavan, used the control phrase to have 10-4TO release him. Xizor regained control of the droid and attempted to have 10-4TO disable the others in the party before they could escape. The droid fired on Pavan and closed on him when he hid behind cover, only to have the Jedi stab it with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. 10-4TO staggered back and fell through a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|window]] and dropped out of sight, where it was set upon by feral droids and destroyed. Pavan and his party later learned from an Imperial defector, the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], that 10-4TO and its rumored databanks had only been a trap for Pavan and were not actually of value to the resistance.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was only told what was necessary. But I do know that the data that were supposedly so vital were, in fact, worthless. The droid was merely a decoy.|Haninum Tyk Rhinann on 10-4TO|<ref name="JT" />}}
[[File:Xizor_Shadow_Syndicate.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Prince Xizor of Black Sun was able to locate 10-4TO and control the droid.]]
10-4TO, also referred to as "Bug Eyes" due to its insectile appearance, was a [[TO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] in the employ of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. As part of the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|largely wiped out]], its survivors scattering into hiding from the Empire. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] was one of these fugitives, hiding in the lower levels of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Vader took interest in Pavan<ref name="JT" /> due to a [[pyronium]] nugget that Pavan had once been given<ref name="PoF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref> and sought to ferret him out from hiding. As such, Vader employed the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] aide [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] to assist in the effort to capture Pavan, though Rhinann was not privy to all of Vader's plan. Vader leaked word that a [[TO-series]] [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] designated 10-4TO had a malfunctioning operating parameter that had caused it to wander around Coruscant unattended, and furthermore was carrying information that could be vital to the fledgling resistance movement dubbed [[Whiplash]] that had arisen to oppose the Empire. 10-4TO believed that its destination was the headquarters for Whiplash, but its databanks contained no such data; the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] entire purpose was a ruse.<ref name="JT" />

10-4TO was turned loose on Coruscant, while word reached Pavan of the droid's alleged importance. A former decorated [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], [[Nick Rostu]], had stumbled upon Pavan's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] as he was [[Death/Legends|dying]] after a battle against Imperial troops while looking for 10-4TO. The Jedi Master told the mission to Rostu and asked him to relay it to Pavan to complete. Rostu was successful and communicated the mission to locate 10-4TO to Pavan, telling him it was the last request of his master. Pavan accepted the mission, assisted by several others, including the emancipated droid [[I-5YQ]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]], [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]], and Rostu. Rostu also informed Pavan of the control phrase for 10-4TO, which would cause the droid to obey whoever had most recently said the phrase; the phrase was "zu woohama," an impolite [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] saying. The ex-soldier volunteered to assist him, but Pavan declined, feeling that he needed to fulfill his master's dying request on his own. To find the droid, Pavan enlisted the help of Laranth Tarak, and the two sought out [[Rokko]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for his services as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] to help them find 10-4TO, who was rumored to be in the [[Yaam Sector]] of Coruscant. Rokko agreed to partner with Tarak and Pavan to find 10-4TO, as the pair had framed the droid as being very valuable if recovered and returned to the Empire for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="JT" />

However, while Pavan was searching for 10-4TO, Rostu was apprehended by the Empire and Vader, knowing that the ex-soldier had known Pavan during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Vader sent him to find Pavan, threatening to destroy his family on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] if he did not cooperate. Rostu reluctantly rejoined the hunt for 10-4TO, conflicted about his choice to betray Pavan to Vader. He was given the droid's location and sent on his way.<ref name="JT" />

Pavan and Tarak were not the only ones searching for 10-4TO. The criminal organization known as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] had also received word of the droid's alleged value from their contacts in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]]. [[Underlord]] [[Dal Perhi]] dispatched one of his most promising members, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], who was pursuing the position of [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], to recover 10-4TO, supplying him with information about the droid, including its control phrase. In fact, Perhi's mission was a ruse to have Xizor eliminated by the [[Nediji]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kaird]], as Perhi saw Xizor's ambition as a threat to his own life. Kaird was also instructed that recovering 10-4TO would be an added bonus if he was successful in eliminating Xizor. Kaird tracked Xizor to the slums where 10-4TO was wandering and attempted to take his life, but his aim was thrown off and Xizor escaped. Kaird pursued him and the two fought, though an electrical surge caused by a torn power cable diminished their combat abilities. As Kaird closed on Xizor, 10-4TO, who was already under Xizor's control, ambushed the Nediji, [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] him with multiple blasts from his arm-mounted [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="JT" />

Xizor ordered 10-4TO to keep firing on Kaird, relenting only to attempt to interrogate Kaird and ascertain who had sent the assassin. Kaird was recalcitrant, and Xizor had 10-4TO resume discharging its weapon into Kaird. However, they were suddenly confronted by Pavan, Tarak, Dhur, and I-5YQ, who had been found and led to 10-4TO's location by Rostu, who had rejoined them without revealing his obligation to Vader. After a brief standoff where 10-4TO bought [[Time/Legends|time]] with a crippling series of stun blasts into Pavan's party, Xizor and 10-4TO fled, bearing Kaird's supine body. They escaped by absconding with Kaird's ship, the [[Surronian (species)|Surronian]] [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Stinger]]'', which Xizor flew to the [[Factory District]] on the other side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When they landed, 10-4TO asked Xizor why they were not at Whiplash headquarters, but Xizor simply reasserted his command of the droid by speaking its control phrase.<ref name="JT" />

[[File:Jax_Pavan.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] defeated 10-4TO by stabbing it with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].]]
Xizor brought 10-4TO and Kaird to an abandoned droid-manufacturing [[Factory/Legends|plant]], where 10-4TO was ordered to deactivate itself for ten minutes. The droid did so, missing an ultimately failed demonstration of a [[human replica droid]] by Xizor. When the droid reactivated itself, Xizor order 10-4TO to accompany him and Kaird to a secret [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]], where he planned on having Kaird brainwashed to attack Dal Perhi in revenge. Upon arrival at the [[Xizor's laboratory|laboratory]], they found that the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] had been slaughtered by the [[feral droid]]s that roamed the Factory District.<ref name="JT" />

Meanwhile, Pavan's party had followed them to the Factory District. Splitting off from the group, Nick Rostu located Xizor, Kaird and 10-4TO. Rostu attempted to convince Xizor that Black Sun had sent him to warn him about the approach of Vader, who was ostensibly en route to retrieve the droid. Xizor pretended to believe him, but instead used his Falleen [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] to influence Rostu, who led the Prince and 10-4TO back to his companions, who were [[Battle in the Factory District|fighting]] off feral droids. Xizor then had 10-4TO advance and stun Pavan and the rest of his party. 10-4TO fired on I-5YQ, who returned fire in such a way that their beams intersected. The resulting explosion knocked I-5YQ offline while 10-4TO stunned the rest of the party so they could be bound with [[Stuncuffs/Legends|forcecuffs]] and restrained Rostu. The Falleen prince was preparing to execute Pavan with his own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when Dhur used a secret command to reactivate I-5YQ, who emitted a painful screech. Rostu then used his knowledge of 10-4TO's command phrase to command the droid to release him, and unsuccessfully assaulted Xizor. Xizor quickly regained control of 10-4TO by uttering its control phrase and ordered it to stop I-5YQ. The droids fired on each other and 10-4TO's beam was able to override the opposing blast and knock I-5YQ back.<ref name="JT" />

With that opponent momentarily disabled, 10-4TO turned its attention to Pavan, who had temporarily eluded it behind cover. When 10-4TO approached, Pavan lunged at the droid, stabbing it between its thoracic and ventral plates with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. 10-4TO staggered back, tripped over a piece of debris, and fell against a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Window/Legends|window]] that had been weakened in the earlier altercation with the feral droids. 10-4TO crashed through it and fell. It was set upon by feral droids and dismantled. I-5YQ investigated its fate and reported back to the others once they were able to escape from Xizor. Pavan and his party would later learn from Haninum Tyk Rhinann&mdash;after the Elomin defected from Vader's service in an abortive confrontation in the Factory District&mdash;that 10-4TO contained no vital data and was only a decoy. Vader had pursued Pavan to the Factory District, tipped off by a tracker implanted in Rostu, but the impending destruction of an unstable [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]&mdash;courtesy of Pavan's lightsaber&mdash;forced him to temporarily break off his pursuit, which allowed Pavan and his party to escape.<ref name="JT" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Zu woohama|The control phrase for 10-4TO|<ref name="JT" />}}
10-4TO was a [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] protocol droid of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] design, controlled by a central processing unit. The exterior of its chassis was glossy [[Color/Legends|black]], while its nickname "Bug Eyes" was derived from its large golden [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which were both insectile in appearance and covered most of its face as well as containing its [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. Two ten-[[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter-long]] segmented antenna joined at the temples of its head added to the droid's resemblance to an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The droid had both thoracic and ventral plating over its torso. 10-4TO was rumored to contain vital information pertaining to the resistance movement in its [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]]. The droid expected to be retrieved by the Whiplash movement, and was surprised when it was claimed by Prince Xizor instead.<ref name="JT" />

When it was set loose on Coruscant in 19 BBY, the droid was programmed to blindly obey anyone who spoke its control phrase of "zu woohama." If multiple people spoke the control phrase, the droid listened to the individual who had most recently said the phrase. 10-4TO was armed with a retractable blaster in its left forearm, which was set on a stun setting, though multiple shots to a target in rapid succession could inflict serious injury or potentially death. The droid also had hands articulate enough to grip objects, including people, with sufficient strength that a trained ex-military Human was unable to wrest free. It was also equipped with [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that allowed it to detect approaching people and had enough initiative to warn its controller of their presence.<ref name="JT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The search for 10-4TO provided the focal point of [[Michael Reaves]]' novel ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', which was published in [[June]] [[2008]]. The search for 10-4TO served to unite Jax Pavan and I-5YQ.<ref name="JT" />

The death of [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' created a discrepancy over the canonicity of ''Jedi Twilight'', as Piell's dying words in the novel are the catalyst for Pavan to search for 10-4TO.<ref name="JT" /><ref name="Citadel Rescue">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] never resolved the conflicting information. This article treats Piell's actions as canon, but does not explicitly state his identity.

On page 303 of Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight, 10-4TO's designation is misspelt as 10-T40.<ref name="JT" />
